summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A., a foreign private issuer, furnishing a notice to shareholders regarding a cash dividend payment. The board of directors, following the April 28, 2026 shareholders' meeting, declared a cash dividend of Ps. 93.385139154438 per share, payable on May 8, 2026 to holders of record on May 5, 2026. The dividend is subject to Argentine Personal Asset Tax and a 7% withholding tax. Payment will be made through Caja de Valores S.A. for local shares and The Bank of New York Mellon for ADR holders. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation.
